notes.title: JULY UPDATE
notes.content:
Hi all,

I hope you're enjoying the final version of ASCENT: Crash Landing!

I've had a little break after the June release, and am now fully caught up on sleep...

Going forward with ASCENT: Crash Landing, please do report any bugs/issues so that I can fix them in future updates. 

If you have chance to leave a review, that would be great also, as it helps a solo developer such as myself on the gigantic library of games that is Steam! :)

It'd be great to know your favourite level/soundtrack/thing from the game in the comments below too.
For me, I think it would be flying the glider around the Hub World!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33531388/a0a086e7e40e52067ec58939830108cfce160893.jpg

Thanks :)

notes.title: ASCENT: CRASH LANDING FULL RELEASE - OUT NOW!
notes.content:
https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1289667599540190933/EBE57F92B0661CB8E832D231F03C53AD322D3785/

4 Years and a Beta release later, I am so happy to be able to announce the full release of ASCENT: Crash Landing! Help Bluu and Blip on their journey through an uncharted and dangerous world in this vibrant, action-packed 3D platformer.

ASCENT: Crash Landing is inspired by classic games I played growing up, such as Crash Bandicoot, Rayman, Croc & Spyro.

Additions to the full release include:

 A new level: Lunar Islands
 More cutscenes
 More achievements
 3 Save slots
 A solo and local co-op option for Spark Islands
 The option to toggle between fullscreen and windowed mode
 Enhanced assets

Thanks for your patience and support throughout.

Enjoy! :)

Dean

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33531388/de7840c00197276c5544b2dc72b1ff679d3a9620.jpg

notes.title: DEVELOPMENT UPDATE
notes.content:
Hi all,

Just over a week to go! The excitement is building!

The full build is now going through the final stages of playtesting.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33531388/501415bf68e16be4269a8517ac7d92211b9f4edd.jpg


In response to player feedback, the co-op level Spark Islands will be getting a Solo option for the full release. This will enable those who play the game solo to unlock the 'Better Together' achievement.

Make sure to keep up to date with everything ASCENT on Twitter too!
https://twitter.com/SPARK_Games_UK


Thanks :)

notes.title: UPDATE / PENDING DEMO REMOVAL
notes.content:
Hi all,

Just a quick update on ASCENT: Crash Landing.

Development is going very well, with only a few bits to tie up :)

The standalone demo available on the store page will be removed on 01/06/2020.

Having been available for a year and a half, I feel it is no longer reflective of the final product that will be launching in a few weeks time.

Just wanted to give the heads up before it gets removed.

Feel free to try it before then though!

Thanks

notes.title: ASCENT: CRASH LANDING (FULL RELEASE) ARRIVES 26/06/2020
notes.content:
The full release of ASCENT: Crash Landing arrives earlier than planned!
A year and a half since its beta release, I can finally announce ASCENT: Crash Landing's full release will be available on the 26th June 2020.

I've been working on this game since 2016, so to have a final release date set feels great!

The full release will include:
 A new level: Lunar Islands
 More cutscenes
 More achievements
 3 save slots
 The option to toggle between fullscreen and windowed mode
 Enhanced assets

Don't forget, you can also start the adventure today!

notes.title: AUGUST UPDATE
notes.content:
Hi all,

It's been a while since my last announcement, so thought I'd post!

I want to say thank you for all the great reviews, which has left ASCENT: Crash Landing sitting at a current score of 85%. I am overwhelmed with the positive comments from the ASCENT community!

I have also been very busy this summer working on my upcoming multiplayer title - Symmetry!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1130400/Symmetry_Early_Access/

This is something very different that I have been producing alongside ASCENT for the last two years, so make sure to check that out also!

Rest assured I will continue development of ASCENT, and plan to have the full game ready around the middle of 2020.

Thanks for being part of the journey!

More soon.

notes.content:

New features include:

 Introduction cutscene
 Inventory on the pause menu - Missing collectables? You can now see any items that remain in each level

Enjoy!

notes.title: V01.1 UPLOADED + HAPPY NEW YEAR!
notes.content:
Updated version of ASCENT: Crash Landing is now live.

Updates include:

- Added speed when rolling. This will help with evading enemies or getting a bit more distance when 'jumping + rolling' over a hole.

- A rework of some areas on the Desert Island level. This is to stop instances of breaking out of the map (sorry glitch hunters!)

- The Elite Aphid boss is now faster when chasing you. This keeps it challenging after Bluu's updated roll function.

Thanks and Happy New Year!

See you in 2019 :D
